overview:
The **Battle of Anaxes** (19 BBY) was a pivotal engagement of the **Clone Wars**, fought on or above **Anaxes**. Republic naval yard siege on anaxes with bad batch commandos infiltrating separatist algorithm core while venator star destroyers exchange turbolaser fire over shipyards.

Archives record this battle across saga films, animated series, Knights of the Old Republic, Old Sith Empire chronicles, and expanded universe sources — anchoring the Clone Wars in both cinematic canon and deep galactic history.
history:
Military historians of the New Republic classify the Battle of Anaxes within the broader **Clone Wars** campaign. Front-line reports describe republic naval yard siege on anaxes with bad batch commandos infiltrating separatist algorithm core while venator star destroyers exchange turbolaser fire over shipyards.

Commanders on both sides leveraged local terrain, orbital support, and Force-sensitive operatives where available. The engagement's outcome shifted regional control and fed into later battles documented across the same war.

For chronology enthusiasts, **19 BBY** places this conflict in the galactic timeline alongside other famous battles of the Clone Wars.
significance: The Battle of Anaxes illustrates how the Clone Wars reshaped the galaxy — through combined arms warfare, political betrayal, and the eternal struggle between light and dark. Its legacy persists in memorials, veteran accounts, and holodramas spanning nine saga films and decades of tie-in fiction.
